comment: Fail-closed hook surfaces (the command guard, kill guard and merge gate fail open since 2026-11-24, so they are not listed): a crash or an unported call on any of these exits 2 (block), never 1 or 3, which Codex and Claude treat as allow. tests/test_pyfront.py checks every hook the installers register as blocking (Claude onFailure block, every Codex hook) is listed. The gate is matched when the subcommand is a key and any argument equals one of its verbs, so a flag before the verb cannot drop gate status.
